PRINTERS.py.summary: The Printers class is a comprehensive iOS page object representing the Printers screen in the mobile application. It extends SmartFlow and implements the Page Object Model pattern for robust test automation. This class provides complete management of printer operations, including listing, searching, sorting, and filtering printers. It supports verification of printer statuses (online/offline), gesture-based interactions (swipe, long press), CRUD operations (add, delete with confirmation dialogs), and access to printer information via icons. The class handles empty states, integrates logging for debugging, and uses explicit waits and error handling for reliable UI automation. It demonstrates best practices for iOS-specific UI interactions, dynamic element location, and comprehensive verification of printer-related UI elements.
